memberdef.name: ConnectProlog

briefdescription.para: Connect the unrolling prolog code to the original loop.

detaileddescription.para: The unrolling prolog code contains code to execute the 'extra' iterations if the run-time trip count modulo the unroll count is non-zero.

This function performs the following:
Create PHI nodes at prolog end block to combine values that exit the prolog code and jump around the prolog.
Add a PHI operand to a PHI node at the loop exit block for values that exit the prolog and go around the loop.
Branch around the original loop if the trip count is less than the unroll factor.

memberdef.name: ConnectEpilog

briefdescription.para: Connect the unrolling epilog code to the original loop.

detaileddescription.para: The unrolling epilog code contains code to execute the 'extra' iterations if the run-time trip count modulo the unroll count is non-zero.

This function performs the following:
Update PHI nodes at the unrolling loop exit and epilog loop exit
Create PHI nodes at the unrolling loop exit to combine values that exit the unrolling loop code and jump around it.
Update PHI operands in the epilog loop by the new PHI nodes
Branch around the epilog loop if extra iters (ModVal) is zero.
